facts.fact: The article was originally published on July 14, 2017 and last updated on December 14, 2022.
The page cites a Perfect Patients study stating that 91% of consumers check out online reviews when looking for a local business online.
facts.quote: Did you know that [91% of consumers](https://www.perfectpatients.com/study-reveals-5-star-reviews-essential-to-chiropractic-marketing/) check out online reviews when looking for a local business online?

facts.fact: The page states that 84% of consumers trust online reviews as much as personal recommendations from friends and family.
facts.quote: And that 84% trust online reviews as much as they trust personal recommendations from friends and family?

facts.fact: The Baywest Health & Rehab example had over 180 positive Google reviews, which it linked to from its homepage.
facts.quote: With over 180 positive Google reviews, they’re able to let their current patients “sell” their prospective patients on their services

facts.fact: Perfect Patients offers three service plans, which the page links to as its pricing options.
facts.quote: Check out our [three service plans](https://www.perfectpatients.com/plans-pricing/) to see what Perfect Patients can do for you.

facts.fact: The page cites a BrightLocal study claiming that photos of the business owner on a business website inspire more trust in visitors than stock photos or no photos at all.
facts.quote: [Studies show](https://www.brightlocal.com/research/images-inspire-trust-local-business-website/) that photos of the business owner on the business website inspire more trust in visitors than stock photos or no photos at all.
